plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Campus Hazards uses your location only while the app is open: to place a hazard report where you are, to show and follow your live position during a trip, and to ask whether a hazard you are near is still there. It is never tracked in the background or sent with your hazard answers.

plugins.cameraPermission: Campus Hazards uses your camera only when you choose to photograph a hazard for AI-assisted reporting.
plugins.photosPermission: Campus Hazards lets you choose a photo to analyze for a hazard report.
